summary: United States Commodity Index Funds Trust filed an 8-K disclosing that sponsor-affiliated parent The Marygold Companies (TMC) entered a definitive agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners for TMC to go private in an all-cash transaction. TMC owns USCF Investments, sponsor of USCI and CPER. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory and change-of-control consents; TMC shares will delist from NYSE. No price, premium or break fee was disclosed. Watch change-of-control approvals and any fund-level impact or advisory arrangements.
